name: The Considine-Rainbow's
source:
Oka Flores and her two best friends were living a normal college life until one ordinary day, they met a strange new girl named Sally, who kidnapped all three of them through a portal. Oka, her friends, and 7 other people got trapped in a deadly game filled with mysterious and terrifying secrets.

[From [url=https://mbphiitslayscipher.itch.io/testing]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
奥卡·弗洛雷斯和两个最好的朋友本来过着普通的大学生活。直到看似寻常的一天，她们结识了一个名叫萨莉的古怪女孩，被她通过传送门一并掳走。奥卡和朋友们，还有另外七个人，都被困在了一场致命的游戏里，里面藏满了神秘而可怕的秘密。

［摘自[url=https://mbphiitslayscipher.itch.io/testing]itch.io[/url]］
